Definition: properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally a year; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand)
BiblicalUsage: Moed is an appointed time, a season, a feast. God sets lights in the firmament for signs and for seasons, He appoints the feasts of the LORD, the lamp burns before Him from evening to morning, and Israel keeps the Passover at its appointed season.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the appointed times are God's calendar, not man's. He fixes the meetings, and His people keep them.
RelatedEvents: Creation; The Tabernacle Is Built; The Passover
